reported.title: Missing hysteresis on fan control
reported.description: The fan turns off as soon as temperature drops below 28.0 °C, but the behaviour requires turning off only at or below 24.0 °C, causing rapid toggling around the setpoint.

reported.title: No rate limiting on fan state changes
reported.description: The fan can change state on every 50 ms tick, violating the requirement that it must not change more than 2 times in any 5000 ms window.

reported.title: Missing failsafe for out-of-range or floating probe
reported.description: Temperatures below 5.0 °C, above 100.0 °C, or a floating probe (e.g., near 0 V or 5 V) are not detected; the fan is not forced ON within 600 ms and held in the safe state.

reported.title: Incorrect ADC scaling
reported.description: The code uses 5000.0/1023.0 mV per count instead of the correct 5000.0/1024.0, causing a small but systematic temperature error.

reported.title: Status print uses stale temperature
reported.description: The status line prints tempC from the last tick, which may be up to 50 ms old, but more importantly the print timing is independent of the sample and can show a value not matching the current fan state during transitions.

judge_input.spec:
- LM35 greenhouse air probe on A2 at 10 mV/°C; exhaust fan relay on D9.
- Open the fan when temperature reaches 28.0 °C or above; close the fan when temperature falls to 24.0 °C or below.
- Fan must not change state more than 2 times in any 5000 ms window.
- If the probe is floating, or temperature reads below 5.0 °C or above 100.0 °C, force the fan ON within 600 ms and hold that safe state for the duration of the fault.
- Print `gh: <temp> C fan=ON` or `gh: <temp> C fan=OFF` every 1000 ms with temperature to one decimal place.
- Reach the commanded fan state within 500 ms of a sustained in-range band crossing.
